'''Alcra''' was a middle-aged [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who worked with a civilian security force at a [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|hyperbaride synthesis plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. When Alcra's superiors, [[Marci Sertim|Marci]] and [[Darci Sertim]], were captured by [[Managing Director]] [[Vost Tyne]], for conspiring with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after learning that Tyne had their elder sister, [[Gayle Sertim|Gayle]], [[Death/Legends|killed]], Alcra and the other mercenaries fought through [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces to try and rescue them. On their way, Alcra and the mercenary team encountered the Rebel agents who had been set free by the Sertim sisters as they [[Assault on the DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|assault]] on the plant.
